title: orders.job-held.v1
description: Work on a garment was suspended. SQ-09 in docs/prd/state-transitions.md section 10 is what a consumer has to know before acting on it: a hold closes the ready state of THIS garment and of no other. A deliver_together partner left standing at ready stays at ready and stays on the delivery queue, and the promise is kept at the door instead — a handover that would strand a live partner is refused at the scan. The alternative, closing the whole parcel's gate on one member's hold, would make a hold a writer of another garment's ready state, which INV-JOB-07 forbids. SQ-09 is proposed and not settled, so a consumer must not infer anything about any other garment from this event and asks IOrderSnapshotQuery at handover. The payload carries the code and not the free-text reason, and neither the approver nor the actor: the hold policy and who signed it off are staff personal data under data-classification section 5.15, and audit (ARCH-008) is the authority on who.
$comment: additionalProperties is true on purpose. conventions.md section 5.5 permits additive changes within a major version, so a subscriber must tolerate a field it has not seen; a closed schema would make every such addition breaking. required lists the fields present when v1 was published — a field added within v1 is optional forever, because a dead-lettered message replayed later carries the payload as it was written.

eventId.description: Identity of this occurrence. Delivery is at least once; consumers de-duplicate on it.

occurredAt.description: When the hold was recorded, in UTC.

aggregateId.description: The garment job, ordered behind its orders.garment-job-created.v1.

organisationId.description: The organisation the garment belongs to.

branchId.description: The branch whose workshop holds it.

orderId.description: The order the garment belongs to.

garmentJobNumber.description: The human reference, so a rack tag can be named.

reasonCode.description: The configured hold reason, by its code. Never null and never blank — the command refuses a hold without one — and deliberately not constrained to a fixed set: the vocabulary is branch configuration, reviewed under open decision OD-10 in docs/prd/assumptions-and-open-decisions.md and seeded by issue #34, not an enumeration this contract may freeze. The value in the example file is a placeholder, not a code this system issues, and a subscriber that hard-codes it has hard-coded nothing. Never free text.

schemaVersion.description: The payload's major version. Agrees with the .v suffix of eventType.
